entries.name: CHR_Keeper_Hands
entries.note: The only skinned mesh: two gloved forearms in Oilcloth Green oilskin cuffs, present in every first-person frame.

entries.name: the Herring Gull
entries.note: 1.10 m wingspan ambient bird, one scripted sheltering appearance under the Gallery rail; never named in the asset table.

entries.name: PRP_LensDrum
entries.note: First-order Fresnel optic, four bullseye panels in a verdigris brass frame, turning at 2.0 rpm at the centre of the hero space.

entries.name: PRP_BurnerAssembly
entries.note: Paraffin vapour burner inside the Lens Drum, the game's light source and the F1 Burner Flameout repair target.

entries.name: PRP_RotationDrive
entries.note: Mercury-float turntable pedestal the Lens Drum rides on; also the plinth the Ignition Lever is mounted to.

entries.name: PRP_IgnitionLever
entries.note: Brass throw lever with a worn wood ball grip on the pedestal's seaward face; the relight verb lives here.

entries.name: PRP_VentFlap
entries.note: Copper cowl damper in the lantern dome at 2.85 m, camera-locked for a 5.0 s Flue Brush repair on F2.

entries.name: PRP_FaultBoard
entries.note: Annunciator panel with eight numbered glass lenses on the landward wall; the game's primary diagnostic instrument.

entries.name: PRP_ClockworkDrive
entries.note: 1907 weight-driven gear train with a visibly turning 84 rpm fly governor; target of F3 and F5.

entries.name: PRP_DriveWeight
entries.note: 118 kg cast-iron cylinder on a wire rope; its descent through the trunk slots telegraphs Weight Run-Out.

entries.name: PRP_WinchCrank
entries.note: Detachable crank with a turned wood grip in its oxide-red socket plate; 6.5 s camera-locked crank for F3.

entries.name: PRP_OilPressurePump
entries.note: Brass hand pump with a 0.46 m lever and a 0–4 bar gauge; 7.0 s camera-locked purge for F4.

entries.name: PRP_BreakerPanel
entries.note: Bakelite six-way breaker panel with a handwritten circuit card; the 3.0 s reset that clears F7.

entries.name: PRP_DieselGenerator
entries.note: 1962 single-cylinder 7.5 kVA set on its concrete plinth; the room-filling mass of the Plant Room.

entries.name: PRP_BatteryBank
entries.note: Twelve glass lead-acid cells on a tarred timber rack; deliberately inert set dressing with a 0.9 lux green emissive.

entries.name: PRP_RadioSet
entries.note: 1958 valve transceiver with a 2,200 K dial glow; carries the three scripted Morse transmissions.

entries.name: PRP_HurricaneLamp
entries.note: The permanently off-hand paraffin lantern and the Carry Key light source; on screen in every frame.

entries.name: PRP_Striker
entries.note: Flint spark striker, tool slot 1, held to the face during the 4.0 s F1 repair.

entries.name: PRP_FlueBrush
entries.note: 0.61 m soot-black wire flue brush on a cane handle, tool slot 2, cure for F2.

entries.name: PRP_PipeWrench
entries.note: 14-inch Stillson wrench, tool slot 3, cure for F5, F6 and half of F8; deferred out of the slice.

entries.name: PRP_Logbook
entries.note: Quarto station log in Oilcloth Green boards, held full-screen at 0.45 m with DOF when Tab is pressed.

entries.name: PRP_OilCan
entries.note: Two-gallon galvanised paraffin can; four placements are the Hurricane Lamp's Wick Charge refill stations.

entries.name: PRP_StormBoard
entries.note: Unpainted spruce plank with webbing handles, carried two-handed at ×0.72 speed to seal a breached pane.

entries.name: MOD_StairTread
entries.note: Cast-iron open-riser diamond-plate tread, 0.192 m rise × 0.24 m going, 24 per level.

entries.name: MOD_StairNewel
entries.note: 0.90 m diameter hollow central column segment the treads socket into, one per 4.60 m level.

entries.name: MOD_StairRail
entries.note: Helical 32 mm bar handrail with stanchions at 0.96 m and oxide-red grip bands, one level per piece.

entries.name: outer stringer
entries.note: Helical outer stringer band at 1.85 m radius that carries the tread ends; implied by the metrics table, absent from the asset table.

entries.name: weight trunk
entries.note: Full-height trunk enclosure with a glazed inspection slot every 1.15 m — the game's key environmental telegraph, never named in the asset table.

entries.name: MOD_TowerWall_Interior
entries.note: 30° arc of limewashed rubble-granite interior wall at 2.40 m inner radius; 12 pieces make a full circle.

entries.name: MOD_TowerWall_Exterior
entries.note: 30° arc of dressed-granite exterior wall at 3.30 m outer radius, seen at arm's length from the Gallery.

entries.name: MOD_FloorPlate
entries.note: 90° cast-iron floor plate quadrant with an optional 0.90 m hatch cut-out and bolted flange.

entries.name: MOD_LanternGlazing
entries.note: One of ten 1.42 m glazing bays — astragal pair plus curved pane; also the F8 Glazing Shatter target.

entries.name: Glazing Panel (shattered)
entries.note: Failed-pane variant of the glazing bay with a hole to board over; required by F8 and never listed in the asset table.

entries.name: MOD_LanternRoofPanel
entries.note: 36° verdigris copper segment of the lantern dome with standing seams, ten to a roof.

entries.name: MOD_GalleryDeck
entries.note: 36° walkway plate with drain slots and a corbel bracket below, 1.10 m wide, ten to a ring.

entries.name: MOD_GalleryRail
entries.note: 36° cast-iron balustrade section, 1.05 m tall and solid below 0.55 m; a gapless collider by design.

entries.name: MOD_TowerDoor
entries.note: Riveted steel door with six dogs and an oxide-red rim; six placements route the storm audio bus.

entries.name: window
entries.note: 0.55 × 0.90 splayed window opening with Gunmetal Wash astragals and glass; implied by two areas and the palette, absent from the asset table.

entries.name: MOD_BulkheadLight
entries.note: Caged 2,700 K bulkhead fixture with ribbed glass, 14 placements; the Service Key light source.

entries.name: caged 2,400 K lamp
entries.note: The Plant Key's single 140 lm caged fixture — a larger, warmer lamp than MOD_BulkheadLight and a separate build.

entries.name: MOD_CableRun
entries.note: Surface-mounted conduit with saddle clips on a 1.0 m repeat; the 1962 rewire, modelled as the ugly work.

entries.name: MOD_RockShelf
entries.note: 6 m wet granite outcrop tile with pooled water recesses; eight tiles make the 18 × 11 m Landing shelf.

entries.name: ENV_SeaPlane
entries.note: 1,800 m Gerstner-displaced ocean plane whose swell height is driven by the storm phase, 2.1 m to 6.8 m.

entries.name: ENV_SkyDome
entries.note: Overcast storm cubemap with cloud base at 180 m and no visible moon; the Storm Key's sky ambient.

entries.name: ENV_CormorantReef
entries.note: 310 m drying rock ridge 1.4 km out on bearing 214°, read only as permanent white water.

entries.name: ENV_CorbieLights
entries.note: MV Corbie's whole visual presence: a masthead + green sidelight two-quad card with a hull silhouette behind.

entries.name: ENV_BeamCone
entries.note: Hand-authored 18° additive volumetric cone at 22% opacity; the only light shaft in the game and its signature image.

entries.name: FX_Rain
entries.note: Wind-sheared Sea Foam rain streaks, 900–3,000 particles/s scaled by storm phase.

entries.name: FX_Spray
entries.note: Coarse salt-spray bursts off the tower base with a 3.2 m radius, on the Gallery and the Landing.

entries.name: FX_Soot
entries.note: Slow black soot fall from the Vent Flap while F2 Vent Soot Choke is active; the visible symptom in slice beat 5.

entries.name: FX_MantleFlame
entries.note: Mantle ignition and steady burn on a Lamp Amber → Mantle White blackbody ramp; the only true amber in frame.

entries.name: burner smoke
entries.note: The visible soot haze of the Dimmed beam state; counted in the seven-particle budget but missing from the asset table.

entries.name: breaking water
entries.note: White water breaking 14 m off the Landing and permanently over Cormorant Reef; budgeted as a particle system, never tabled.

entries.name: gust debris
entries.note: Airborne matter carried on the 2.4 s gust envelope outdoors; budgeted as a particle system, never tabled.

entries.name: glazing flex
entries.note: One pane visibly bowing during the Squall beat, paired with SFX_Glass_Flex; the slice's only scripted glass deformation.

entries.name: Glazing Shatter
entries.note: Pane failure burst and the wind-through-hole air stream that persists until F8 is boarded over.

entries.name: FX_GlassRain
entries.note: Rain-on-glass shader for the lantern and Watch Room glazing, streaks driven by wind direction.

entries.name: FX_WaterOnDeck
entries.note: Animated sheeting-water shader for the Gallery deck segments.

entries.name: TRIM_Iron_A
entries.note: One of the two 2048² trim sheets the whole building is built from: rivet strips, flange bands, tread nosings, bracket profiles.

entries.name: TRIM_Paint_A
entries.note: The second 2048² trim sheet: limewash edges, oxide-red hazard bands and the stencilled numerals 1–8.

entries.name: unpainted render
entries.note: Salt Grey dry stonework finish for the Oil Store and Plant Room walls; a second interior wall material the asset table never named.

entries.name: bare concrete
entries.note: Tiling concrete for the 1962 blasted vault's floor, walls and generator plinth; the only concrete in the tower.

entries.name: chalked tally of winding times
entries.note: Hand-authored chalk decal of winding times going back to 1968, at 1.50 m on the Weight Well wall.

entries.name: derrick stub
entries.note: The landing derrick that has not been used in six days — the Landing's main silhouette landmark.

entries.name: mooring bollard
entries.note: Cast-iron bollard on the rock shelf, set dressing for the unusable landing.

entries.name: iron ladder going nowhere
entries.note: A fixed iron ladder on the Landing that leads nowhere; pure scale and mood dressing.

entries.name: 200 L paraffin drum
entries.note: 1.60 m drum instanced four times on the Oil Store gantry; the station's bulk fuel.

entries.name: timber gantry
entries.note: The timber rack the four paraffin drums sit on, against 000–060° of the Oil Store.

entries.name: wire-rope coil
entries.note: Coiled spare wire rope on the Oil Store floor, matching the Drive Weight's rope.

entries.name: trunk inspection plate
entries.note: Bolted access plate at the foot of the weight trunk, carrying the Oil Store's one oxide-red hazard band.

entries.name: wall exhaust penetration
entries.note: The generator's exhaust through the wall at 045° with its salt-stained cowl.

entries.name: guide rails
entries.note: Four vertical guide rails the Drive Weight runs between over its 11.4 m fall.

entries.name: spares crib
entries.note: 2.20 m run of Bone Lime timber shelving against 180–260° of the Weight Well.

entries.name: labelled bins
entries.note: Instanced labelled parts bin that fills the spares crib shelves.

entries.name: hydrometer jar
entries.note: Glass hydrometer standing in a jar on the Battery Room shelf; the room's only small readable object.

entries.name: shelf
entries.note: Generic bracketed wall shelf reused for the hydrometer jar and the Radio Set.

entries.name: chart table
entries.note: 1.20 × 0.80 m table under the Watch Room window, the fiction's centre of gravity.

entries.name: chart
entries.note: The station chart with Cormorant Reef pencilled in; the only in-world map of the hazard.

entries.name: bunk
entries.note: 1.90 × 0.75 m bunk, made up with an Oilcloth Green blanket; two placements, both empty since 1971.

entries.name: barometer
entries.note: Tarnished brass aneroid barometer at 1.60 m reading 961 mb and falling 1.4 mb/h.

entries.name: mug
entries.note: A single mug on the chart table — the smallest piece of evidence one person lives here.

entries.name: ledger
entries.note: Closed station ledger on the chart table, distinct from the carried Logbook.

entries.name: workbench
entries.note: 1.60 m bench at 180° of the Service Room, with the third Oil Can beneath it.

entries.name: STORM BOARD rack
entries.note: Wall rack at 240° holding two Storm Boards; the fetch point for the F8 repair.

entries.name: oil feed standpipe
entries.note: Vertical feed pipe from the Service Room to the burner, with an oxide-red valve; the line F4 airlocks.

entries.name: 0.40 m cast-iron step
entries.note: The step under the Vent Flap that makes the tallest reachable fixture reachable; required by F2 and absent from the asset table.

entries.name: hatch to STAIR SHAFT
entries.note: 0.90 × 0.90 m hinged hatch cover over the stair opening; the opening the escapement is heard through.

entries.name: Storm Shutter
entries.note: Sliding iron shutter in a salted track at 120° and 240°, blocking 0.8 m of gust wall; operable, never tabled.

entries.name: UI_HoldRing
entries.note: 56 px Mantle White radial fill ring; the only feedback on every repair, including in total darkness.

entries.name: UI_InteractGlyphs
entries.note: Eight 24 px verb glyphs — hold, crank, pump, throw, read, light, carry, open — plus the WRONG TOOL state.

entries.name: UI_AnnunciatorLenses
entries.note: Eight numbered lens states (off / red steady / amber pulse) driving the Fault Board, with the greyscale-safe numerals.

entries.name: UI_LogbookPages
entries.note: The two-page spread: objective and watch time left, the redactable Annunciator/Symptom/Cure index right.

entries.name: UI_RangeLine
entries.note: Acid-etched hairline and nine-tick scale on glazing bay 1; the diegetic readout of Lateral Clearance.

entries.name: Reticle
entries.note: 3 px dot at 22% opacity growing to 5 px at 70% over an interactable; on screen at all times.

entries.name: Wind Vignette
entries.note: Screen-edge darkening ramping 0% → 38% as Wind falls 75 → 0; the only breath readout in the game.

entries.name: Tool Wheel
entries.note: 320 px three-sector radial selector at 0.25 timescale, auto-closing at 2.0 s.

entries.name: Fault Ticker
entries.note: Lower-centre single line of annunciator text for 3.5 s; the only screen-corner element in the game.

entries.name: Clearance Readout
entries.note: Optional upper-centre `CLEARANCE 128 m` numeric at 2 Hz; accessibility toggle, off by default.

entries.name: Subtitle line
entries.note: Non-speech caption line above the ticker; listed in the HUD table and deferred.

entries.name: UI_TitlePlate
entries.note: 3840² still of the Lantern Room at 1/120 s; the full-bleed backdrop of the title screen.

entries.name: Title
entries.note: Title screen layout over UI_TitlePlate: New Watch, Continue (greyed in the slice), Options, Quit.

entries.name: Boot logo
entries.note: 2.5 s skippable boot sequence ahead of the title.

entries.name: Options — Gameplay
entries.note: Difficulty, hold-to-repair toggle, hold-tool-wheel toggle, crouch toggle, Fault Ticker on/off.

entries.name: Options — Video
entries.note: Resolution, window mode, quality preset, VSync, frame cap, FOV 55–95, motion blur, head bob, camera roll.

entries.name: Options — Audio
entries.note: Six bus sliders — Master, Storm, Machinery, Music, UI, Player — plus a mono downmix toggle.

entries.name: Options — Accessibility
entries.note: Clearance Readout, greyscale-safe annunciator, Long Night, shake and impulse reduction, hold-time multiplier, high-contrast prompt.

entries.name: Options — Controls
entries.note: Full rebind for keyboard+mouse and gamepad, sensitivity sliders, invert X and Y.

entries.name: Pause
entries.note: Resume, Options, Restart Watch, Quit to Title at timescale 0.0, plus the 1.0 s resume countdown ring.

entries.name: Loss
entries.note: `SHE STRUCK.` with elapsed watch time and the fault active at grounding.

entries.name: Win
entries.note: `SHE PASSED.` and the Station Record card: clearance at pass, faults cleared, longest dark interval.
